description: Download Windows Spotlight images and optionally set them as desktop wallpaper or lock screen.

script: if ($release.tag_name -notmatch '^v2\.\d+\.\d+$') { throw 'The latest stable release is not a supported Spotlight Downloader v2 build.' }
if ((@($release.assets | ForEach-Object { $_.name }) -notcontains $assetName)) { throw 'The latest release does not contain the expected portable ZIP asset.' }

notes: Uses the official portable ZIP for the Windows .NET 9 release, not the separate Lockscreen Setup installer.

SpotlightDownloader.exe is exposed as a Scoop command. The bundled batch scripts are not added as shortcuts because they create their archive/cache beside the script inside Scoop's versioned app directory; use the command-line --outdir option for data you want to keep across updates.
